captions.detailed: A frameless-glass flush sunroof cassette integrated into a flat, rounded grey body panel. The assembly features a dark translucent glass panel surrounded by a thin, light-grey perimeter seal frame. Beneath the body panel, twin black prismatic rails are mounted, allowing the glass panel to slide rearward. This sliding mechanism allows the glass panel to retract fully beneath the rear section of the main body panel, simulating an automotive sunroof operation.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a frameless-glass flush sunroof cassette. It should feature a flat, rounded grey body panel with a square opening, a translucent glass panel with a thin perimeter seal, and twin under-mounted prismatic rails that allow the glass panel to slide rearward beneath the rear portion of the body panel.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. First, the main body panel is created as a thin plate with rounded corners, and a rectangular sunroof opening is cut out of its front half. Second, twin longitudinal prismatic rails are modeled as extruded profiles with triangular guide tracks and mounted underneath the body panel. Third, the glass panel is modeled with matching rounded corners, a thin surrounding seal frame, and small slide shoes at its corners that mate with the rails. Finally, a prismatic joint is defined to allow the glass panel assembly to slide along the longitudinal axis of the rails.
